d3-flextree 2.1.2 by Chris Maloney, https://github.com/Klortho/d3-flextree

Shipped as vendor/d3-flextree.js, sha256 87bc42c5f28cfbf64c81bb6d9cba80c97965a0088a19b82c9b2d3ac265166d23
Changed for Plaintext Family History: loads from a plain script tag and uses
D3 7's d3.hierarchy instead of bundling d3-hierarchy 1. The import lines and
the package.json version lookup are replaced by a small wrapper; the layout
code is unchanged.
